recipe.visualDefinition: A central female figure in a vibrant red gown stands amidst a stylized, snow-dusted evergreen forest under a soft grey sky, with elegant script typography floating in the upper center.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant red subject against a desaturated, monochromatic winter background
Triangular composition formed by the expansive gown train
Textural contrast between soft snow, sharp pine needles, and satin fabric
Verticality of the trees framing the central subject
coreInvariants: Expansive red satin gown with ruffled hem
Soft, diffused studio lighting on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, full-body shot with the gown occupying the lower third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The saturated red of the gown's bodice and the expansive train.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down the vertical line of the body to the wide red train, then upward to the floating typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample grey space in the upper third to accommodate title text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool greys and whites (background and snow)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic silver and gold (typography and jewelry)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the subject versus low saturation/high value in the environment.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly red, white, grey, and silver

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
Extended swashes on initial and terminal characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Upper case 'M' and 'G' feature exaggerated, elegant flourishes
The dot of the 'i' is replaced or accented by a golden star flare
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary, smaller script in a solid red sits above the primary silver title for a layered hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Soft vignetting at the bottom edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal, high-flourish calligraphic style.
Offers similar swash options and elegant weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-fashion portrait of a woman in a massive red satin ballgown with a ruffled train, standing in a snowy evergreen forest under a flat grey sky. Ensure the trees are heavily dusted with white snow and the lighting is soft and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered script text in the upper third. The top line should be smaller and red; the bottom line should be large, silver-beveled, and feature a golden star flare on a character.

verificationChecks: Is the red gown the most saturated element?
Is the text legible against the grey background?
Does the snow look realistic on the pine needles?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the metallic bevel on text
Shade of grey in the sky
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the model
Unique signature flourishes of the original artist name
postGenerationChecks: Check for seamless blending between the model and the snow
Ensure the red gown does not have digital artifacts
Verify the typography has a 3D metallic appearance
Confirm the star flare is positioned correctly on the text
Check that the background trees provide a sense of depth
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject[Vibrant Red Gown] + Environment[Snowy Grey Forest] + Typography[Silver Beveled Script] = Holiday Glamour Aesthetic
